use_cases.name: Create person, position and assignment
use_cases.goal: Bring a new worker onto the record as one durable person with an employment and an assignment against a vacant position, with policy attributes resolved and the joining chain started.

stakeholders.interest: Payroll group is set explicitly and identity mismatches block pay, not joining.
The new worker's shift group, default shift and location are ready before the first punch.
Joins on the planned date even if a statutory identifier needs correction.
Duplicate decisions and policy overrides are recorded with a reason.

use_cases.trigger: An offer is accepted or a data load presents a new worker.
preconditions: HR operations holds entity scope for the hiring legal entity.
The target position exists in the position register.
Worker classes, designations and payroll groups are configured.
postconditions_success: One person, one employment under the legal entity and one assignment exist, with payroll group and location set independently.
The resolved policy vector is stamped on the assignment and the joining chain is running.
people.worker.hired is emitted with person_id, assignment_id, worker_class, location_id and doj.
postconditions_failure: No assignment is created against a filled, frozen or abolished position.
Where a likely duplicate exists, no new person is created until HR records a decision.

main_flow.action: Searches for an existing person by name, date of birth, Aadhaar token, PAN token and mobile before creating one.
Scores candidate matches and checks whether any is above the 0.85 confidence threshold.
Creates the person with identity and contact facts: name, gender, date of birth, nationality, mobile, email, Aadhaar, PAN and UAN.
Selects or creates the position and confirms it is vacant and budgeted.
Creates the employment against the legal entity with start date, probation months and notice days.
Creates the assignment: position, worker class, designation, band, manager, shift group, payroll group and location.
Resolves policy attributes from the worker class and stamps them on the assignment, keeping any reasoned overrides.
Starts the joining chain and emits the hire event.

alternate_flows.condition: A candidate scores at or above 0.85.
steps: Nucleus platform shows the existing record and the new entry side by side and emits people.person.duplicate_suspected.
HR operations decides Same person or Different person and the decision is logged with actor and reason.
If Different person, creation continues; same name, date of birth and site is routine and is not a reason to block.

alternate_flows.condition: The search finds the person as a former worker.
steps: HR operations routes the case to rehire instead of creating a new person.
alternate_flows.rejoin: Ends the use case (continues in PPL-UC-007)

alternate_flows.condition: HR operations needs a policy value different from the worker class default.
steps: HR operations enters the override value, a reason and an effective date on the assignment screen.
Nucleus platform stores the override as a temporal fact.

exception_flows.condition: Aadhaar or PAN details do not match the verification source.
exception_flows.handling: Joining proceeds; a payroll-blocking flag is raised so the worker is held out of pay until corrected.

exception_flows.condition: The selected position is filled, frozen or abolished.
exception_flows.handling: The assignment is blocked with the position status and reason shown.

exception_flows.condition: Payroll group or location is left blank on the assumption that one will default from the other.
exception_flows.handling: Save is refused until both are chosen explicitly; neither defaults from the other.

exception_flows.condition: An override is entered without a reason or effective date.
exception_flows.handling: Validation fails at write time and the override is not saved.

nfrs: Duplicate search returns candidates in under 1 second at p95 for a tenant of 50,000 persons.
Aadhaar and PAN are stored only as tokens and are masked on every screen by default.

user_stories.want: the system to search for an existing person before I create a new one
user_stories.so_that: a returning or duplicate worker does not end up with two records

acceptance.then: both records are shown side by side with a match score and HR must choose Same person or Different person

acceptance.given: HR chooses Different person with reason 'Different PAN and mobile'
acceptance.then: a new person is created and the decision is logged with HR's identity and reason

user_stories.so_that: headcount and budget stay consistent with the position register

use_cases.name: Change an assignment with an effective date
use_cases.goal: Apply an approved change to an assignment attribute from a stated effective date, triggering attendance recompute or payroll arrears where the change reaches back into past periods.

stakeholders.interest: Closed payroll runs are never rewritten; retro effects arrive as arrears.
Attendance is recomputed when a change affects time policy.
Reporting-line changes route approvals to the right person from the right date.

use_cases.trigger: A grade, manager, location, cost centre or worker class change is needed.
preconditions: The worker has an active assignment within HR operations' entity scope.
An approval chain exists for the change type.
postconditions_success: A new assignment version exists with valid_from equal to the effective date and the prior version end-dated.
Attendance recompute and payroll arrears are queued where required.
postconditions_failure: On rejection, the assignment is unchanged and the requester is told the reason.

main_flow.action: Raises a change request naming the attribute, the new value, the effective date and the reason.
Approves the change per the change type's approval chain.
Writes a new assignment version with valid_from set to the effective date.
Checks whether the change affects time policy: class, rest days, shift group, grace exemption or location.
Checks whether the change affects pay for a closed payroll period.

alternate_flows.condition: The change affects time policy.
steps: Nucleus platform queues an attendance recompute for the affected date range and emits time.recompute.requested.

alternate_flows.condition: The change affects pay in a closed period.
steps: Nucleus platform queues arrears in the next open run and emits payroll.arrears.requested.
The closed run remains exactly as paid.

alternate_flows.condition: The change originates from the ERP system's employee master.
steps: Nucleus platform receives the inbound change and creates the change request with the ERP system as source.
The request follows the same chain as a manual change.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date or reason is missing.
exception_flows.handling: The request is rejected at submission with the missing field named.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date falls inside a closed payroll period.
exception_flows.handling: The request is flagged as retro and the approver sees the flag and affected periods.

exception_flows.condition: The approver rejects the change.
exception_flows.handling: No version is written; HR operations is notified with the reason.

exception_flows.condition: Any process attempts to update a closed payroll run for the change.
exception_flows.handling: The update is refused; only arrears in the next open run are permitted.

nfrs: The new assignment version is visible to time, leave and payroll within 1 minute of approval.
An attendance recompute for a 90-day range for one worker completes within 2 minutes.

user_stories.want: to record an assignment change with an effective date and reason
user_stories.so_that: the change applies from the right day and the history explains why

acceptance.given: E1018's manager is E1017
acceptance.when: HR raises a change to manager E1021 effective 2026-12-01 with reason 'Line rebalancing'
acceptance.then: after approval a new assignment version exists from 2026-12-01 and the earlier version is retained

acceptance.given: HR submits a change with no effective date
acceptance.then: the request is rejected with 'Effective date is required'

user_stories.so_that: paid payslips and filed returns stay unchanged

user_stories.so_that: past days reflect the policy that actually applied

use_cases.name: Resolve worker class and policy attributes
use_cases.goal: Give every time, leave, payroll and compliance computation one authoritative policy vector for a worker on a given date, built from class defaults, assignment overrides and designation-band attributes.

stakeholders.interest: Contractual workers get no weekly off and third-party helpers differ from third-party employees without code changes.
Daily-wage workers are paid on days present and OT follows each worker's eligibility basis.
Client policy differences are configured on class, sub-category, designation or assignment rather than coded.

use_cases.trigger: Any time, leave, payroll or compliance computation requests the policy for a worker on a reference date.
preconditions: Worker classes, designations and employment categories and sub-categories are configured with effective dates.
postconditions_success: The caller receives a resolved policy vector valid at the reference date, or 'not employed' when the date is outside the assignment span.
postconditions_failure: No defaults are returned for a date on which the worker had no assignment.

main_flow.action: Reads worker class defaults as at the reference date: rest days, wage type, OT eligibility, leave eligibility and statutory set.
Overlays assignment-level overrides valid at the reference date, each carrying its override reason.
Overlays designation-band attributes: grace exemption, leave band, OT default and notice days.
Returns the resolved policy vector to the calling time, leave, payroll or compliance engine.

alternate_flows.condition: Rest-day applicability is being resolved.
steps: Nucleus platform takes the value on the employee record if present.
Otherwise it takes the employment sub-category default, then the employment category default; the first non-empty value wins.

alternate_flows.condition: The class wage type is Daily.
steps: Nucleus platform marks the vector so payroll pays on days present and attendance generates no weekly off.

exception_flows.condition: A caller passes today instead of the reference date for a past computation.
exception_flows.handling: The resolver uses the supplied reference date only; class values are never read as at today for a past date.

exception_flows.condition: An override without a reason is found.
exception_flows.handling: Such an override cannot exist because it fails validation at write time; resolution does not compensate at read time.

exception_flows.condition: The reference date is before the assignment start or after its end.
exception_flows.handling: The resolver returns 'not employed', never class defaults.

nfrs: Policy resolution returns in under 5 ms at p95 per worker-date, and under 30 seconds for 5,000 workers over a 31-day month.
Time, leave, payroll and compliance call the same resolver; no module holds its own copy of policy logic.

user_stories.want: contractual daily-wage workers to be paid only for days present with no weekly off
user_stories.so_that: pay follows the contract terms without manual adjustment

acceptance.then: no weekly off is generated for E1032

acceptance.given: E1032 is present 24 days in a 30-day month
acceptance.then: E1032 is paid for 24 days

user_stories.so_that: each sub-category gets its entitlement without a code change

acceptance.when: a week of attendance is run
acceptance.then: E1034 receives a Sunday rest day and E1053 does not

acceptance.given: an employee-record rest-day value of N for a WC-3PE worker
acceptance.then: the employee-record value wins over the sub-category default

user_stories.so_that: ordinary working-day extra hours do not create OT for them

acceptance.given: E1034 works 8 hours on his Sunday rest day

use_cases.name: Control positions and sanctioned strength
use_cases.goal: Maintain approved manpower by org unit, designation and location and expose filled, open and headroom figures derived from live assignments and requisitions.

stakeholders.interest: Hiring stays within approved manpower and budget.
Can see headroom before raising a requisition.
Replacement hiring points at the exact vacated position.

use_cases.trigger: A manpower budget is approved or a vacancy arises.
preconditions: Org units, designations and locations exist.
The user holds entity and location scope for the units concerned.
postconditions_success: Sanctioned strength is recorded with effective date and approver, and the strength board shows sanctioned, filled, open and headroom.
postconditions_failure: No sanction change is saved without an effective date and approver.

main_flow.action: Records sanctioned strength by org unit, designation and location with effective date and approver.
Derives the filled count from active assignments and the open count from open requisitions.
Exposes headroom as sanctioned minus filled minus open for requisition checks.
On separation, sets the position to vacant with last incumbent and vacated date.

alternate_flows.condition: Headroom would become negative because a hire is needed above sanction.
steps: Finance records an override with reason and approver.
Nucleus platform shows the negative headroom with the override reference on the strength board.

exception_flows.condition: The sanction has no effective date or approver.
exception_flows.handling: The sanction is rejected with the missing field named.

exception_flows.condition: A user tries to edit filled or open counts directly.
exception_flows.handling: The counts are read-only; they are always derived from assignments and requisitions.

exception_flows.condition: A requisition would take headroom below zero without a recorded override.
exception_flows.handling: The requisition is blocked and the headroom shortfall is shown.

nfrs: The strength board for an entity of 5,000 positions loads in under 3 seconds.
Filled and open figures reflect a new assignment or requisition within 1 minute.

user_stories.want: to record approved manpower by department, designation and location
user_stories.so_that: hiring can be checked against what was sanctioned

use_cases.name: Change an org unit or reorganise
use_cases.goal: Rename, re-parent, merge or split organisation units with an effective date so that the hierarchy changes going forward while history remains intact.

stakeholders.interest: The organisation chart and their team view reflect the new structure from the effective date.
Cost centre changes align with the new structure and sanctioned strength moves with the unit.
The structure on any past date can be reproduced.

use_cases.trigger: A restructure is approved by management.
preconditions: HR operations holds entity scope over every unit affected.
The org units involved exist in the current hierarchy.
postconditions_success: New effective-dated versions of the affected org units, and of positions where needed, are written; earlier versions remain readable.
The organisation chart shows the new structure from the effective date.

main_flow.action: Selects an org unit, for example OU-113 Quality Assurance, and chooses rename, re-parent, merge or split.
Enters the new structure, cost centre where it changes, the effective date and the reason.
Previews the impact: positions, assignments, approval routes and sanctioned strength rows that move.
Submits the change for approval with the impact preview attached.
Approves the reorganisation through the approval chain.
Writes new effective-dated versions of the org units and moves positions and sanctioned strength rows with them.
Rebuilds the organisation chart and department views from the effective date from reporting relationships.

alternate_flows.condition: The change involves several units and many people at once.
steps: HR operations stages the change as a mass reorganisation change set.
alternate_flows.rejoin: Ends the use case (continues in PPL-UC-013)

exception_flows.condition: The new parent would create a cycle in the hierarchy.
exception_flows.handling: The change is rejected and the cycle path is shown.

exception_flows.condition: The effective date or reason is missing.
exception_flows.handling: The change cannot be submitted until both are entered.

exception_flows.condition: Merging units would give derived filled counts above the combined sanction.
exception_flows.handling: Nucleus platform flags the negative headroom for Finance to resolve with an override or a new sanction.

nfrs: A reorganisation affecting 500 positions is applied in under 2 minutes after approval.
Reading the hierarchy as at any past date returns the structure in force on that date.

use_cases.name: Capture, classify and track documents
use_cases.goal: Store a worker's documents with class, extracted fields and expiry so that verification is controlled and expiries trigger timely reminders.

stakeholders.interest: Expiring licences and permits are renewed before they lapse.
Only low-confidence extractions need manual verification.
Can upload from a phone, even offline, and is reminded before a document expires.

use_cases.trigger: An employee or HR uploads a document.
preconditions: Document classes and their expiry requirements are configured.
The uploader has access to the person's document vault within scope.
postconditions_success: The document is stored encrypted with class, extracted fields, confidence and expiry, and reminders are scheduled.
postconditions_failure: The document is not saved without a class, and verified values are never overwritten.

main_flow.action: Uploads a document in the document vault and selects or accepts the inferred class.
Classifies the document, extracts fields and stores extraction confidence without overwriting any verified value.
Schedules expiry reminders at the configured intervals of 60, 30 and 7 days.

alternate_flows.condition: HR operations uploads on the worker's behalf.
steps: HR operations uploads within its scope and the document records HR as uploader.

alternate_flows.condition: Extraction confidence is below 0.80.
steps: Nucleus platform routes the document to the HR verification queue.
HR operations confirms or corrects the fields and records verified_by.

alternate_flows.condition: The worker uploads from the mobile app without connectivity.
steps: The upload is queued on the device and sent when connectivity returns.

exception_flows.condition: No class is selected, or an expiring class has no expiry date.
exception_flows.handling: The upload is rejected with the missing field named.

exception_flows.condition: An extracted value differs from a value already verified.
exception_flows.handling: The verified value is kept and the difference is sent to the verification queue.

nfrs: Classification and extraction complete within 30 seconds of upload for files up to 10 MB.
Documents are encrypted at rest and identifiers in them are tokenised.

user_stories.so_that: I can complete my records without visiting HR

use_cases.name: Rehire, transfer between entities or change worker class
use_cases.goal: Move a worker into a new employment or assignment while keeping one person record and deciding tenure and gratuity continuity by rule.

stakeholders.interest: Prior service is recognised where the rules say it should be.
The old employment is closed cleanly and the new one starts on the right payroll group.
Statutory identifiers such as UAN carry over to the same person (to be validated by Legal).

use_cases.trigger: A former worker rejoins, a worker transfers between legal entities, or a worker converts to another class.
preconditions: The person record exists.
Continuity rules for tenure and gratuity are configured per scenario.
postconditions_success: The same person holds a new employment or assignment; the previous one is closed with an end date; continuity outcome is recorded with the rule applied.
postconditions_failure: No new employment or assignment is created and the current one is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Searches for the person and opens the existing record found by identity attributes.
Chooses the scenario: rehire, entity transfer or class change, with the effective date.
Shows prior employments and assignments with dates, entity, class and separation reason.
Applies the configured continuity rule and proposes tenure start and gratuity service start dates.
Creates the new employment, or for a class change a new assignment, against a vacant position.
For a transfer, ends the old employment the day before the new one starts in the other entity.
Re-resolves policy attributes for the new class and assignment, then starts the joining chain.

alternate_flows.condition: HR operations needs a continuity outcome different from the rule's proposal.
steps: HR operations enters the override with a reason.
The override is routed to the Director / approver for approval before it applies.

exception_flows.condition: The target position is filled, frozen or abolished.
exception_flows.handling: Creation is blocked with the position status shown.

exception_flows.condition: The person has an open payroll-blocking identity flag.
exception_flows.handling: The move proceeds but the flag carries to the new employment and continues to block pay.

nfrs: Continuity proposal is computed in under 2 seconds from full employment history.
No scenario creates a second person record for the same individual.

user_stories.want: to rehire a former worker on the same person record
user_stories.so_that: history, statutory identifiers and documents stay together

acceptance.then: a new employment is created under the existing person_id and no new person is created

use_cases.name: Detect duplicate persons
use_cases.goal: Catch likely duplicate person records at onboarding and on ERP synchronisation, and let HR decide each case, never merging or rejecting automatically.

stakeholders.interest: Sees credible duplicates only and decides with both records in view.
No person is paid twice under two records.
Two genuine workers with the same name and birth date at one site are not merged.

use_cases.trigger: A person is created during onboarding or arrives from the ERP system's employee master.
preconditions: The match threshold is configured (default 0.85).
Identity tokens for Aadhaar and PAN are available where captured.
postconditions_success: Each suspected duplicate has a recorded HR decision; confirmed-distinct pairs are not flagged again.
postconditions_failure: An inbound ERP record held as a suspected duplicate is not applied until decided.

main_flow.action: Receives a candidate person from onboarding or from the ERP system's inbound employee master.
Scores the candidate against existing persons on name, date of birth, mobile, PAN token, Aadhaar token and site.
Raises a suspected duplicate for any score at or above the threshold and emits people.person.duplicate_suspected.
Reviews both records side by side with the attributes that matched and those that differ.
Decides Same person or Different person with a reason.
Applies the decision and logs it; a Different person pair is remembered so it is not raised again.

alternate_flows.condition: HR decides Same person.
steps: Nucleus platform links the candidate to the existing person and routes the case to rehire or record update.
No second person record is created.

alternate_flows.condition: The score is below the threshold.
steps: Nucleus platform proceeds with creation without raising a case.

exception_flows.condition: An inbound ERP record matches an existing person on name and birth date but carries a different PAN token.
exception_flows.handling: The inbound record is held, the case is raised to HR and the ERP integration log shows the hold.

exception_flows.condition: Any process attempts to merge or reject a candidate without an HR decision.
exception_flows.handling: The action is refused; duplicates above the threshold are always decided by HR.

nfrs: Matching runs in under 1 second per candidate against 50,000 persons.
Precision of raised cases is monitored monthly; a confirmed-distinct pair is never raised twice.

user_stories.want: to decide suspected duplicates with both records side by side
user_stories.so_that: two real people are never merged and one person is never created twice

acceptance.given: a candidate scoring 0.91 against an existing worker at LOC-PLA with matching name and date of birth but different mobile and PAN
acceptance.then: both records are shown with matching attributes highlighted and differing ones marked

acceptance.given: HR decides Different person with reason 'Different PAN'
acceptance.when: the same pair is evaluated again next month
acceptance.then: no new case is raised

user_stories.so_that: no worker is set up twice for pay

use_cases.name: Maintain job architecture
use_cases.goal: Define job families, job profiles, grades and bands, and competency requirements as effective-dated objects that positions and assignments reference.

stakeholders.interest: Positions describe what the role needs, which guides hiring and development.
Grades and bands drive pay ranges consistently.
Client grading structures are configured, not coded.

use_cases.trigger: A new role type is introduced or the grading structure changes.
preconditions: HR operations holds the job-architecture permission for the tenant.
postconditions_success: Job family, profile, grade or band versions exist with effective dates and are linked to positions.

main_flow.action: Creates or edits a job family, for example Manufacturing Engineering, with an effective date.
Defines a job profile, for example Senior Engineer — Machining, with purpose, grade or band and required competencies.
Validates that the grade or band exists and that competency levels are within the defined scale.
Links positions to the profile, for example POS-2214 and POS-2216.
Approves the new or changed profile.
Publishes the profile as a new version; linked positions read the version valid at each date.

alternate_flows.condition: A profile is to be retired.
steps: HR operations sets an end date on the profile.
Nucleus platform checks that no active position references it after that date.

exception_flows.condition: A retirement is requested while active positions still reference the profile.
exception_flows.handling: The retirement is blocked and the referencing positions are listed.

exception_flows.condition: A change is attempted as an in-place edit.
exception_flows.handling: A new version is written and the prior version is end-dated.

nfrs: Profiles support at least 30 competency requirements each without degrading position screen load beyond 2 seconds.

user_stories.want: to define job profiles with band and required competencies
user_stories.so_that: positions share a consistent definition of the role

acceptance.given: profile Senior Engineer — Machining with band B and competency CNC programming at level 3
acceptance.when: it is published and linked to POS-2214 and POS-2216
acceptance.then: both positions show the profile, band B and the competency requirement

acceptance.given: HR edits the profile to require level 4 effective 2027-04-01
acceptance.then: level 3 is shown

user_stories.want: profiles in use to be protected from retirement
user_stories.so_that: positions are never left pointing at a retired profile

acceptance.given: profile Operator — Assembly referenced by POS-2225 and POS-2226
acceptance.then: it is blocked and both positions are listed

acceptance.given: both positions are moved to another profile
acceptance.then: it is accepted with the end date recorded

use_cases.name: Maintain multiple and matrix hierarchies
use_cases.goal: Hold supervisory, cost-centre, location, legal-entity, project and dotted-line hierarchies side by side, each effective-dated and usable for approval routing and data scope.

stakeholders.interest: Project leads approve project-related items without becoming line managers.
Data scope follows the right hierarchy for each role.
Cost-centre roll-ups follow the cost hierarchy, not the reporting line.

use_cases.trigger: An organisation needs a relationship other than the solid reporting line for routing, reporting or scope.
preconditions: Hierarchy types are enabled by the implementation consultant.
postconditions_success: The worker holds effective-dated relationships in each relevant hierarchy, and chains and scopes reference the chosen hierarchy type.
postconditions_failure: No relationship is saved and existing routing is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Enables hierarchy types: supervisory, cost-centre, location, legal-entity, project and dotted-line.
Assigns a dotted-line manager to a worker for a project with start and end dates.
Validates there is no cycle and that the dotted-line manager is active in the period.
Configures an approval chain step to resolve its approver from the project hierarchy.
Routes matching requests to the dotted-line manager while the relationship is valid.
Keeps data scope on the solid reporting line unless a role is explicitly scoped to another hierarchy.

alternate_flows.condition: The dotted-line relationship has ended.
steps: Nucleus platform resolves the step to the solid-line manager instead.

exception_flows.condition: The new relationship would create a cycle in that hierarchy.
exception_flows.handling: The relationship is rejected and the cycle is shown.

exception_flows.condition: A dotted-line manager attempts to read compensation of a worker outside their payroll group.
exception_flows.handling: Compensation fields return null as for any reader outside the payroll group.

nfrs: Approver resolution across any hierarchy type completes in under 100 ms at p95.

user_stories.want: to give a worker a dotted-line project manager for a fixed period
user_stories.so_that: project approvals go to the project lead without changing the reporting line

acceptance.when: E1020 submits a project expense on 2026-12-05
acceptance.then: the project step routes to E1018 and the line step to E1021

acceptance.given: the same request type on 2027-02-10
acceptance.then: the project step resolves to E1021 because the dotted line has ended

user_stories.want: dotted-line relationships to grant no compensation visibility
user_stories.so_that: project leadership does not expose salaries

acceptance.given: E1018 is dotted-line manager for E1020
acceptance.then: attendance and project data are visible and compensation fields are null

acceptance.given: E1021 is E1020's solid-line manager with compensation permission for PLANT-BLR
acceptance.then: permitted compensation fields are shown

use_cases.name: Manage global and expatriate assignments
use_cases.goal: Record host and home assignments with split and shadow payroll indicators, assignment allowances and visa or permit expiry tracking.

stakeholders.interest: Knows which country pays what, and when a shadow calculation is needed.
Visas and permits never lapse during an assignment.
Allowances and dates of the posting are clear and correct.

use_cases.trigger: A worker is posted to another country or entity for a defined period.
preconditions: The host entity exists in the tenant or is registered as an external host.
Assignment allowance types are configured.
postconditions_success: A host assignment exists linked to the home employment, with payroll indicators, allowances and permit expiry tracked.
postconditions_failure: No host assignment is created and the home assignment is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Creates a host assignment linked to the worker's home employment with start and planned end dates.
Sets payroll indicators: home-paid, host-paid or split, and whether shadow payroll is required.
Adds assignment allowances such as housing and cost-of-living with currency and frequency.
Uploads visa and work permit documents with their expiry dates.
Schedules permit expiry reminders and shows the expiry on the assignment.
Reviews the indicators and allowances and confirms payroll set-up for the posting.

alternate_flows.condition: The posting is extended.
steps: HR operations changes the planned end date with a reason and effective date.
Nucleus platform checks that permits cover the new end date.

exception_flows.condition: A permit expires before the planned assignment end date.
exception_flows.handling: A compliance alert is raised to HR operations and the Compliance owner immediately.

exception_flows.condition: Split payroll is selected without the share for each country.
exception_flows.handling: Save is refused until shares are entered.

nfrs: Permit expiry alerts fire on the configured day with no misses, verified by monthly reconciliation.

user_stories.want: to record a host assignment with payroll indicators
user_stories.so_that: payroll knows who pays the worker during the posting

acceptance.given: E1009 is posted abroad from 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31 with split payroll 40% home and 60% host
acceptance.then: it is linked to E1009's LE-01 employment and both shares are stored

acceptance.given: split payroll is selected with no shares
acceptance.then: the save is refused with 'Enter the share for each country'

user_stories.want: an alert when a work permit ends before the posting
user_stories.so_that: the worker never works without a valid permit

acceptance.given: E1009's work permit expires on 2027-12-31 and the posting ends on 2028-03-31
acceptance.then: an immediate alert is raised to HR operations and the Compliance owner

acceptance.given: a renewed permit to 2028-06-30 is uploaded
acceptance.then: the alert closes and reminders are rescheduled from the new expiry

use_cases.name: Record dependants, nominees and emergency contacts
use_cases.goal: Hold a worker's dependants, emergency contacts and nominations for PF, gratuity Form F and insurance, with shares that total exactly 100% per nomination type.

stakeholders.interest: Their family receives benefits as they intend.
Gratuity Form F and PF nominations are complete and current (to be validated by Legal).
Emergency contacts are reachable during an incident.

use_cases.trigger: A worker joins, has a family event, or chooses to update nominations.
preconditions: Nomination types and the relationships allowed for each are configured.
postconditions_success: Dependants and contacts are saved; each nomination type has nominees whose shares total 100%, versioned and approved.
postconditions_failure: No nomination with shares not totalling 100% is saved; the prior nomination remains in force.

main_flow.action: Adds dependants with name, relationship and date of birth, and at least one emergency contact.
Selects a nomination type (PF, gratuity Form F or insurance) and adds nominees from dependants.
Enters a share percentage for each nominee.
Validates that shares for the nomination type total exactly 100% and that each nominee's relationship is allowed.
Submits the nomination with supporting documents where required.
Verifies and approves the nomination through the approval chain.
Saves the nomination as a new version effective from approval and retains the prior version.

alternate_flows.condition: HR operations captures the details on behalf of a worker without app access.
steps: HR operations enters dependants and nominations and attaches the signed form.

exception_flows.condition: Shares for a nomination type total other than 100%.
exception_flows.handling: Submit is disabled and the running total is shown against the 100% target.

exception_flows.condition: HR rejects the nomination.
exception_flows.handling: The worker is notified with the reason and the previous nomination remains in force.

nfrs: Share validation responds as the user types, within 200 ms.
Nominee identity details are masked for all roles except HR operations within scope.

use_cases.name: Stage and commit a mass reorganisation
use_cases.goal: Prepare moves of org units, positions and people as one effective-dated change set, preview routing and security impact, and commit it atomically.

stakeholders.interest: On the effective date their team, inbox and data access change together.
Security impact is visible before commit, not discovered afterwards.
Attendance recompute is triggered where time policy changes.

use_cases.trigger: A restructure moving many units, positions or people is approved.
preconditions: HR operations holds entity scope for every unit in the change set.
postconditions_success: All changes in the set are written as effective-dated versions in one transaction, and downstream recompute and events follow.
postconditions_failure: None of the changes in the set are applied.

main_flow.action: Creates a change set with an effective date and reason.
Adds moves of org units, positions and people to the set, singly or by upload.
Previews impact: new approvers for open and future requests, scope changes per principal, and headroom changes.
Reviews the preview and adjusts the set until the impact is as intended.
Approves the change set with the preview attached.
Commits every change in one transaction as effective-dated versions.
Emits assignment change events and queues attendance recompute for workers whose time policy changed.

alternate_flows.condition: The change set must be withdrawn before its effective date.
steps: HR operations requests withdrawal with a reason.
Nucleus platform writes closing versions so the structure on and after the effective date is restored.

exception_flows.condition: Any single change fails validation during commit.
exception_flows.handling: The whole set rolls back and the failing item is reported.

exception_flows.condition: A move would leave an open approval without an approver.
exception_flows.handling: The preview flags it and commit is blocked until a reroute target exists.

exception_flows.condition: A move would place a position into a filled state conflict.
exception_flows.handling: The preview flags the conflicting position and commit is blocked.

nfrs: A change set of 2,000 moves previews in under 60 seconds and commits in under 5 minutes.
Commit is atomic: either every change is applied or none is.

user_stories.want: to preview who will approve what after a reorganisation
user_stories.so_that: no request is stranded or misrouted on the effective date

acceptance.given: a change set moving OU-114 Maintenance at LOC-PLA under a new head
acceptance.then: each open request from OU-114 workers is listed with its current and future approver

acceptance.given: an open request whose future approver cannot be resolved
acceptance.then: commit is blocked and the request is listed

acceptance.given: a change set moving 40 workers from LOC-PLA to LOC-PUN
acceptance.then: it lists the principals who gain or lose visibility of each worker

acceptance.given: commit of 40 moves where one fails validation
acceptance.then: none of the 40 moves is applied and the failing one is reported

use_cases.name: Explore the interactive organisation chart
use_cases.goal: Show an interactive organisation chart built from reporting relationships, with drill-down, vacancies, headcount and span of control, filtered by the viewer's scope.

stakeholders.interest: Sees their team, vacancies and spans at a glance.
Uses the chart to spot over-wide spans and long-open vacancies.
Finds who leads which team.

use_cases.trigger: A user opens the organisation chart.
preconditions: Reporting relationships exist on assignments.
The viewer's entity and location scope are resolved.
postconditions_success: The chart shows only nodes within the viewer's scope, with headcount, span of control and vacancies.
postconditions_failure: No node outside the viewer's scope is shown.

main_flow.action: Opens the organisation chart, which centres on their own node.
Builds the chart from reporting relationships on current assignments, filtered by the viewer's resolved scope.
Shows each node's headcount and span of control, and vacant positions as distinct vacancy nodes.
Drills down to a sub-team or up to the manager's manager.
Filters by legal entity or location, or switches to the department-wise view.
Re-renders the chart and offers an export of the visible view within scope.

alternate_flows.condition: The viewer selects an as-at date in the past.
steps: Nucleus platform rebuilds the chart from relationships valid on that date.

exception_flows.condition: Scope resolution fails for the viewer.
exception_flows.handling: The chart shows only the viewer's own node and a message that the wider chart is unavailable.

exception_flows.condition: The viewer selects a location outside their grant.
exception_flows.handling: The location is not offered in the filter list.

nfrs: A chart of 5,000 nodes renders the first level in under 2 seconds and expands any node in under 500 ms.
The chart is navigable by keyboard and screen reader to WCAG 2.2 AA.
